generic.description: No provider limit is imposed by the generic preproduction skill.

seedance-2.5.description: Use the current provider contract and scene block limit for Seedance 2.5.

higgsfield.description: Resolve the current Higgsfield model contract at execution time.

magnific-seedance-2.5.description: Seedance 2.5 through the Magnific suite. 24 s is the longest single job observed to succeed (2026-09), not a published cap; 480p and 720p were the observed output resolutions. Verify the live limit and parameters in magnific-operator before execution.

tapnow-draft.description: TapNow through its MCP connector. Jobs are 5 or 10 seconds with at most one reference image and no model choice; join longer pieces locally. 864x496 at 24 fps was the observed output of the draft tier (2026-10); the fast and quality tiers are not yet observed. Verify the live limits in tapnow-operator before execution.
